lines.text: Hngh... This back is killing me...
Ah, sunshine. Here to experience urban sanitation work? Sorry, my back's hurting again ... I didn't notice you just then...
I'm Yu Xiuli. Just call me Auntie Yu.
As you can see, we gotta clean up these stains. Looks like the work of pantailbeasts...
Oh, that's so kind of you. I was supposed to show you how we keep the city clean.
I'm sorry my back disagrees. You'll have to help me out!
But since you lack the sanitation tools, you should use mine.
Jet ... drone? For cleaning?
Aiyooo... my back is acting up again. It's been a while since I had to clean so many stains. One wrong move and my back starts screaming...
Oh, of course. Here. There's plenty of it too.

options: Is this the venue for Wuling Sanitation Open Day?
Are you in charge of Wuling Sanitation Day activities?
No worries. I got my jet drone.

lines.text: Drones nowadays are so incredible!!

options: Let's handle the rest in one go!
Maybe later. I gotta take care of something.

lines.text: Cleaned it up real quick, didn't you? Such efficiency! You'll definitely nab the title of Sanitation Elite!
I'll think about that later. Well, I'm glad to see plenty of energetic sunshine like you in Wuling. I can finally retire in peace!
I wanted to use the event and help the city out one last time. But my back disagrees!
Haha. Maybe I got lucky and ran into a truly "honorable" event participant!
Better tell my grandkid about this. You'll be a shining example!
So, what's after this...? Where are we going again?
I'm getting old. Gotta keep a work log in case I forget... Ah, the flower beds near the Ecological Research Station!
You did well, sunshine. Enjoy a break. I have to head home and put some herbs on this creaky back.
But how did the Residential Area get in such a mess? The neighborhood pantails should be tame and cuddly. Can it be...?

options: See you at the Ecological Research Station.

lines.text: Maybe Auntie Yu is right about this. A mystery critter is making a mess of this place.
But why ruin the bulletin board...? Oh, I get it!
They're trying to deface our heroes, corrupt our people, and conquer Wuling City! Such evil...!
We jog here everyday but it's all dirty now...
The grown-ups told me that a very, very bad mystery creature wants us to stop exercising.
Once everyone gets soft and weak, it'll start to hunt and eat us!
Oh! Power is back! But why is it just *mine* energy panel that broke...?
I get it! It's a test! Someone wants to see our reaction! That must be it!
If nobody cleaned it up on time, their next move is to bring down the Wuling City power supply...
This must be the work of a mystery critter... Hmph. Better keep my doors and windows closed properly. Who knows what they're up to.
